description_en: Queries the details of a scaling configuration. You can query a scaling configuration by its ID to learn about its details such as the temporary storage size, number of IPv6 addresses, and bandwidth of the elastic IP address (EIP). The scaling configuration details can be obtained as a YAML file
description_zh: 调用API DescribeEciScalingConfigurationDetail，通过伸缩组的伸缩配置ID查询对应的伸缩配置信息（例如临时存储空间大小、IPv6地址数、弹性公网IP的带宽等），支持输出为YAML格式
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-eci-scaling-configuration-detail --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw00000 --scaling-configuration-id asc-bp1ffogfdauy0nu50000 --output-format YAML --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEciScalingConfigurationDetail

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling configuration belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩规则所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group to which the scaling configuration belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩配置所属的伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling configuration based on which elastic container instances are created
parameters.help_zh: ECI类型伸缩组的伸缩配置ID
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The output format. Set the value to YAML
parameters.name: output_format
